name: Coverage / runway bar
purpose: A READOUT that answers one question: does the money cover what is already scheduled, and until when? It states a verdict with a date, shows the arithmetic that produces it (balance − committed = buffer), and draws the split on a bar. ⚠ THE BAR IS A GATED Progress-bar, COPIED BYTE-FOR-BYTE — this component draws no new bar. What it adds is the verdict, the arithmetic and the legend. PROPOSED #204 (itinerary row 94, slug runway-bar) — NOT GATED, NOT RULED, AND ITS PROVENANCE IS A TEST FIXTURE (see provenance). Fintech semantics are Dave's (the Kpi-tile precedent, s182-D2).

props.name: committed
props.$note: The fill — aria-valuenow. ⚠ CLAMPED to balance in the SHORT state, because a progressbar cannot express overflow. The true figure appears in the legend, the arithmetic and aria-valuetext.

props.name: buffer
props.$note: Derived: balance − committed. Rendered through the Amount-display money-format primitive (symbol before, no space, tabular lining, U+2212 minus, MONOCHROME).

props.name: verdict
props.$note: ★ THE POINT OF THE COMPONENT. A WORD AND A DATE — 'Covered through 31 May', 'Covered to 24 May', 'Short from 12 May'. Never a colour on its own.

props.name: verdictTone
props.$note: Renders the Status-indicator RAG-tint chip. ⛔ WHICH VERDICT MAPS TO WHICH TONE IS A SEMANTIC BINDING AND IS DAVE'S — proposed here, not ruled.

props.name: showMath
props.$note: The balance/committed/buffer definition list. Turning it off makes this a Progress bar (see antiPatterns).

props.name: size
props.$note: 4px and 8px rules — Progress-bar's own two sizes, same token pair, unchanged.

variants.name: covered
variants.use: Buffer positive. Bar under the full track.

variants.name: tight
variants.use: Buffer nearly gone. Same anatomy, different numbers, different WORD — NOT a different colour.

variants.name: short
variants.use: Committed exceeds balance. Bar pinned at 100%, shortfall shown as a signed figure and a date. ⛔ NO RED — see tokens.$note.

variants.name: emphasis
variants.use: 8px rule where the coverage is the primary content of its region. Progress-bar's .pb-lg size.

tokens.fill: progress/complete — theme INK in all four themes since s175-D1 (Mono/Console #1A1A1A | #FFFFFF, Legacy #333333 | #FFFFFF, Supercharge #13110E | #F7F6F4)
tokens.track: progress/incomplete — #F0F0F0 | #484848 in Mono/Console/Legacy; #DFDEDC | #413934 in Supercharge via the neutral→warm DNA rebind
tokens.label: text/default @ .t-cm-label
tokens.border: border/subtle — the buffer swatch outline and the arithmetic total rule
tokens.verdict: rag/success + rag/success-tint | rag/warning + rag/warning-tint — the Status-indicator chip, copied byte-for-byte from Account-card
tokens.radius: border-radius/indicator (resolves 0 in Mono — square, the angular rule; 4px in Console via the cascade)
tokens.$note: ⛔⛔ NO GREEN/RED WAS INVENTED FOR THE BAR, AND THAT IS THE POINT. A cash-runway meter is exactly where a healthy/critical binding gets improvised. The bar is INK ON TRACK in every state INCLUDING 'short', inherited unchanged from the gated Progress-bar, whose meta gives the reason in Dave's own terms: 'Progress is STRUCTURE, not status (Dave 2026-07-21) — hence the ink pair rather than a RAG colour.' Coverage is a QUANTITY. The VERDICT is a separate object carrying a word and a date. NO NEW TOKEN IS WANTED OR MINTED.

motion.entry: The fill grows to its value — Progress-bar's transition, copied.
motion.reducedMotion: Progress-bar's own clause copied: the fill still MOVES to its final position (the value must be reachable), it just arrives without an animated sweep. Global collapse also present.

responsive.rule: Fluid to a 480px max-width column; the bar is width:100% of its container. Legend and head wrap. Verified at 1400px and 480px.

mustNotNeighbour: A Chart-bullet of the same figures (pick one — and if you have a TARGET, the Chart-bullet is the right one)
A bare Progress bar of the same figures (the readout already contains one)
commonPatterns: cash coverage for a scheduled payment run

accessibility.role: The readout is role="group" + aria-labelledby. The bar is role="progressbar" with aria-valuenow/valuemin/valuemax and a full aria-valuetext, copied from Progress-bar's non-percentage specimen.
accessibility.valueText: aria-valuetext carries the whole sentence including the VERDICT AND THE DATE, so AT hears the answer, not just a ratio.
accessibility.openQuestion: ⚠ role="progressbar" vs role="meter" is OPEN and Dave's. progressbar is used because it is what the gated parent carries. THE SEARCH THAT FAILED TO SETTLE IT (s202-D3): `grep -rn 'role="meter"' knowledge/snippets/` → 2 hits, BOTH of them the new snippet's own prose, i.e. ZERO in the 87 pre-existing snippets; `grep -icE '\bmeter\b' knowledge/_rulings.json` → 0. Nothing in the store rules it either way.
accessibility.notColourAlone: Enforced THREE ways on every specimen: the verdict WORD (and date) in the chip, the full arithmetic in text at 17.4:1, and aria-valuetext on the bar. Strip every colour from this component and it still says everything it means (1.4.1).
accessibility.passive: interactive:false throughout. No focus indicator, nothing in the tab order — so the 44px minimum hit area does not apply. Stated so the absence is DECLARED rather than assumed.
accessibility.math: The arithmetic is a real <dl>, so the sum is in source order and readable by AT rather than being a visual arrangement.

antiPatterns: ⛔ COLOURING THE BAR RED WHEN COVERAGE IS SHORT, or green when it is healthy. Progress is structure, not status (Dave 2026-07-21, carried in progress-bar.meta). Coverage is a quantity. The verdict word and the date are the carriers.
⛔ ADDING A TARGET MARKER. A bar with a target IS a Chart-bullet and should be one. This component has no target — it has a horizon.
⛔ ADDING QUALITATIVE BANDS behind the bar. Same reason: those are Chart-bullet's qualitative ranges.
Shipping the bar WITHOUT the verdict and the arithmetic. That is a Progress bar and should be one — the readout is the whole component.
Rendering the verdict as a colour with no word or date.
Using this for a MULTI-category composition (three or more segments). Two segments of one balance at one instant is a rule; more than that is Chart-donut or Chart-bar's stacked column.
Using this for coverage OVER TIME. That is Chart-stacked-area.
Letting aria-valuenow exceed aria-valuemax in the short state instead of clamping it and carrying the true figure in aria-valuetext.
Relying on the verdict chip's DOT. It is 1.98:1 / 2.18:1 standalone (measured #204) — the inherited Account-card / Status-indicator finding.

$differsFrom.Chart-bullet: ★ THE BRIEF'S FLAGGED NEIGHBOUR, AND THE ANSWER IS NO. Chart-bullet's own purpose line: 'a measure bar against a COMPARATIVE TARGET MARKER and QUALITATIVE PERFORMANCE RANGES', intent 'comparison', built as an SVG figure at a fixed 580px with a real <table class="dv-table"> (dv-005), a data/series/1 measure fill and an ink target tick. A runway bar has NO target, NO bands, NO SVG, NO data table and NO dataviz series token. THE TELL: a Chart-bullet needs a TARGET; a runway bar has no target, it has a HORIZON — nothing is measured against a goal, the question is how far the money reaches. If you have a target, use Chart-bullet. This component must never grow one.
$differsFrom.Progress-bar: ★ THIS IS THE REAL PARENT, and it is not close, it is exact. Progress-bar's own commonPatterns already lists 'savings goal / LIMITS METER', and its third specimen is a non-percentage determinate bar ('Savings goal · 1,450 of 2,000') carrying its domain in aria-valuetext. Committed money on a track of total balance is that same shape. THE BAR IS COPIED BYTE-FOR-BYTE — .pb-track/.pb-fill, 4px and 8px, progress/complete on progress/incomplete, role and aria — AND NOTHING NEW WAS DRAWN AT THE BAR LEVEL. What this adds is the READOUT: the verdict-with-a-date, the balance-minus-committed arithmetic, and the two-key legend. A runway readout without those IS a Progress bar and should be one.
$differsFrom.Chart-donut / Chart-stacked-area: Those are composition charts across MANY categories, or across TIME. This is ONE balance split into exactly TWO parts at ONE instant, and it is a rule, not a chart.
$differsFrom.Kpi-tile / Stat-card: Those state a metric and its CHANGE (or the shape of the change) against a prior period. This states a FORECAST — a horizon date — from a balance and a schedule. There is no delta and no arrow anywhere in this component, which is also why it does not touch the live two-red arrow seam.

$decisionsForDave: ★ FIRST: should this component exist at all? It originates in a fitness-test fixture. Nothing in the store asked for it. Declining it is a completely legitimate answer and the itinerary row can be closed as 'not a component'.
If it does exist: is the shape right? Verdict + buffer figure + bar + legend + arithmetic — or is that too much for one component and the arithmetic belongs in a Summary?

★ The verdict vocabulary and its chip binding. 'Covered through 31 May' → success tint; 'Covered to 24 May' → warning tint; 'Short from 12 May' → warning tint. Should 'short' be the ERROR seat instead? That touches the two-red law and I deliberately did not take it.
role="progressbar" vs role="meter" — nothing in the store rules it (searches quoted in accessibility.openQuestion).
The SHORT state's clamped bar. Pinning at 100% is honest but silent about the overflow. Should there be a dedicated overflow treatment, and if so, what is it that is not a red bar?
The legend's buffer swatch takes a 1px border/subtle outline so the track colour is visible against the page in light mode. That is a specimen choice, not a rule.
Should the emphasis (8px) variant exist here, or should a consumer just compose Progress-bar's own emphasis size?
